name: animation
description: Named animation clip: tracks of keyframes over time. With usage "animate" it is a scene timeline (for exporting to video, Lottie, SVG); with usage "puppet" it is a clip of the puppet (wave, blink, idle) that the app or its AI plays live. Built with set_keys. In a puppet clip, the drivers add their poses on top of the animation; a scene (animate) is shown without params or drivers: setup + keyframes.
help: Named animation clip: keyframe tracks over time. Animate = a scene timeline to export; Puppet = a clip the app or its AI triggers live.

usage.help: animate = a scene timeline (Animate mode); puppet = a clip of the puppet (Puppet mode, one button each).
usage.description: animate = scene timeline (Animate mode, exported to video/Lottie); puppet = clip of the puppet (Puppet mode, one button per clip, played by the app).

duration.description: Duration in seconds. No keyframe can go past it.

loop.help: once = plays once and holds the end; loop = starts over; pingpong = goes back and forth.
loop.description: once = plays once and holds the end; loop = starts over; pingpong = goes back and forth.

description.help: What the clip does, in a few words. The app's AI reads it to choose when to play it.
description.description: What the clip does, in a few words (in English if the app is in English). The app's AI reads it to choose when to play it.

fade.help: Puppet: seconds it takes to fade in and out when played live (0 = instant, e.g. a blink).
fade.description: Puppet only: seconds of the fade in and out when played live (0 = instant, like a blink). Smooth curve.

next.help: Puppet, once clips: the clip played when this one starts fading out (e.g. surprised → idle).
next.description: Puppet only, once clips: the clip played when this one starts fading out (start_talking → talking, surprised → idle). A loop clip becomes the base; a once clip, a gesture.

blend.help: Puppet: override = replaces what is below by its weight; additive = adds its difference from the setup (e.g. breathing).
blend.description: Puppet only: override = replaces what is below by its weight; additive = adds its difference from the setup (breathing). Non-numeric values are not added.

auto.help: Puppet: off = the app plays it; repeat = plays by itself every repeat_min…repeat_max s (blink); always = always looping (breathing).
auto.description: Puppet only: off = the app plays it; repeat = the runtime plays it by itself every repeat_min…repeat_max seconds at random (blink); always = always playing in a loop (breathing, usually additive). The app does not play auto clips.

repeat_min.help: Puppet, auto repeat: shortest wait between plays, in seconds.
repeat_min.description: Puppet with auto repeat only: minimum wait between two plays, in seconds.

repeat_max.help: Puppet, auto repeat: longest wait between plays, in seconds.
repeat_max.description: Puppet with auto repeat only: maximum wait between two plays, in seconds.

tracks.help: Keyframes per object and property: { object: { property: [ { t, value, ease } ] } }. In a Puppet clip, parameters animate their value; a scene keys the values themselves.
tracks.description: { object_id: { property: [ { t, value, ease } ] } }, with the same shape as the values of a pose. t in seconds (0…duration), value absolute as in the setup, optional ease (linear by default, step, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, the strong ease-in-quad/-cubic/-expo/-back with their -out and -in-out, or [x1, y1, x2, y2] as a CSS cubic-bezier; the guide describes each one) for the span leaving that keyframe. Only in a puppet clip, a param is animated with { param_id: { value: [...] } }; a scene does not animate params (it keys the values, the active of a switch, or copies a pose with set_keys and pose).
